content: tink-java latest 1.22.0 (June 2026). For minSdk 26 no Tink needed: javax.crypto has AES/GCM/NoPadding (Conscrypt) and SecretKeyFactory PBKDF2WithHmacSHA256 since API 26. Argon2 NOT in Android platform (needs native dep like argon2kt/lazysodium). androidx.security:security-crypto (EncryptedSharedPreferences/EncryptedFile) deprecated April 2025 at 1.1.0-alpha07 — do not use.
